people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
translations.bsb: Judah will have one portion bordering the territory of Reuben from east to west.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
translations.asv: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, Judah, one portion.
